messages:
release-ops: Quick weekly release train bulletin. Two items: 1) small cadence change for next 3 sprints, 2) planned deprecation of runtime-v1 next month. Read on for rollout status and action items.

maya: TL;DR: were shifting mainline deploys from Tue/Thu -> Wed only for two weeks to reduce cross-team conflicts during infra migration. This is temporary.

luca: FYI this helps the runtime team finish the v2 rollout without juggling parallel trains. No feature freeze; only coordination change.

release-ops: Runtime deprecation: runtime-v1 will be marked deprecated on YYYY-MM-DD (4 weeks). Targets: migrate any pinned Dedicated pools, update Canary configs, and update docs. Post-deprecation removal planned 2 weeks after that.

infra-lead-anna: Status: v2 images ready in staging. Were running compatibility smoke across common models. No major regressions so far. Plan: staggered migration of Dedicated pools by region, starting with eu-central on week 1.

oncall-jess: Oncall note: expect some alert noise during migrations (warmup and cache misses). Well throttle traffic and watch p95. Pager schedule unchanged.

release-ops: Action items (owners & due dates):
- @luca: publish migration runbook and checklist by EOD today
- @infra-lead-anna: start EU migration Monday, aim for 50% capacity shift by Wed
- @deploy-bot: add deprecation banner to console and flag in API responses for pinned customers
- @maya: update release calendar and customer comms template

deploy-bot: Added deprecation banner to the Console (visible to org admins). Will emit API warnings for calls to runtime-v1 starting next Tuesday.

luca: Runbook link posted: https://intranet/runbooks/runtime-v1-migration (includes rollback steps, performance checks, KV cache eviction guidance).

release-ops: Risks: pinned Dedicated customers may need extra lead time. If any customer cannot migrate, open a migration-exempt ticket and well schedule a manual carve-out.

maya: CS/Account teams notified. Well offer migration windows and assistance for high-commit customers.

oncall-jess: Ill add temp alert knobs to reduce paging during controlled migrations.

k8s-bot: Pre-migration canaries scheduled for eu-central at 03:00 UTC Mon. 3 pods, 2 replicas each.

release-ops: Thats the brief. Well post a short update at the end of week with progress + any rollback notes. Ping this thread for migration issues. :triangular_flag_on_post:
